record.original_question: Let B be the complete Boolean algebra of all regular open subsets of the real line. Is the Scott space Sigma B sober?

evidence.quote: Question 3.6. ([15]) Let B be the complete Boolean algebra of all regular open subsets of the reals line. Is the Scott space SigmaB sober?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{R}$ denote the real line with its usual topology. A subset $U \subseteq \mathbb{R}$ is called regular open if $U = \mathrm{int}(\overline{U})$, where $\overline{U}$ is the closure and $\mathrm{int}$ the interior in $\mathbb{R}$. Let $B$ denote the collection of all regular open subsets of $\mathbb{R}$. It is well known that $B$, ordered by set inclusion, is a complete Boolean algebra (in particular a complete lattice, and hence a directed-complete partially ordered set).

For a dcpo $(P,\le)$, the Scott topology $\sigma(P)$ on $P$ has as its open sets those subsets $U \subseteq P$ which are upper sets (i.e. $x \in U$ and $x \le y$ imply $y \in U$) and which are inaccessible by directed suprema (i.e. for every directed set $D \subseteq P$ with $\sup D \in U$ one has $D \cap U \neq \emptyset$). The resulting topological space is denoted $\Sigma P$.

A topological space $X$ is sober if every nonempty irreducible closed subset of $X$ (a nonempty closed set that cannot be written as the union of two proper closed subsets) is the closure of a unique point of $X$.

Question: Is the Scott space $\Sigma B$ sober?
artifact.status_search_result: Web searches on the sobriety of the Scott space of the complete Boolean algebra of regular open subsets of the real line returned related work on non-sober Scott spaces of complete Heyting algebras and frames (e.g., constructions by Xu, Xi, and Zhao), but no source was found that explicitly resolves the specific question about $B = \mathrm{RO}(\mathbb{R})$. The status appears to remain unresolved in the literature accessible via search.

status_evidence.title: A complete Heyting algebra whose Scott space is non-sober
status_evidence.snippet: Construction of a complete Heyting algebra with non-sober Scott topology, addressing related sobriety questions for Scott spaces of frames.
status_evidence.claim: Related sobriety questions for Scott spaces of complete lattices have been studied, but no resolution for the regular-open algebra of the reals is found.

status_evidence.title: Some open problems on well-filtered spaces and sober spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Survey listing open problems concerning sobriety of Scott spaces of complete lattices.
status_evidence.claim: Sobriety of the Scott space of certain complete lattices is listed among open problems.
